# Pull Request Checklist

## Description
Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

---

## Type of Change
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

---

## Quality Checks

- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Build succeeds
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
- [ ] No secrets added

---

## AI Compliance (if AI-assisted)

- [ ] AGENTS.md rules followed
- [ ] Changes are minimal and scoped
- [ ] No unrelated refactoring done
- [ ] Regression tests added if applicable

---

## Additional Notes
Any extra context for reviewers.
